basic_info.description: This is a fantastic opportunity for a three-level family home on a flat tree-lined block in a coveted Noe Valley neighborhood. Within a short stroll, one can reach the vibrant 24th Street shopping, cafe, and dining corridor; the plaza, playgrounds, and dog parks are all within reach.  Upon entering the home's entry level is greeted by an East-facing living room, a large dining room with built-in cabinets, an eat-in kitchen, and a powder room. All 3 bedrooms are on the upper level. In addition, the 4th bedroom is on the lower level through an interior stairway, which is perfect for guest quarters. This same level completes a family room, an office alcove, and a tiled bathroom with a walk-in shower. Laundry room. A walk-out sun deck off the kitchen complements this comfortable and spacious family home, and a beautifully landscaped flower garden wraps around the large patio, which is perfect for family and friends gatherings. This happy home is filled with natural light year-round, ideal for indoor and outdoor living to its best in this coveted neighborhood known for its sunny weather in the city of San Francisco.
